Sr. Pre-qualification Criteria Technical Prequalification criteria- The bidder shall have in the last seven years, manufactured and supplied, at least one straight tube OR U tube, shell and tube heat exchanger under TPI inspection of M/s LRA/TUV/BV/PDIL/ D NV /SGS/BAX Counsel (any one of these) directly to reputed Fertilizer/Refinery/Petrochemical/O il & gas/Power Plants/EPC companies, fulfilling the following conditions in a single purchase ord er. 1) Exchanger shall have minimum 54 Nos U tubes/ 108 Nos straight tubes. 2) Minimum size of tubes shall be ¾” OD. 3) MOC of tubes shall be SS 304 or any other grade of austenitic/duplex stainless steel. 1 4) The exchanger shall be hydro tested at a minimum pressure of 12.3 kg/cm2. Bidder shall submit the following documents in support of the above supply. 1) Self attested copy of purchase order and drawing clearly showing type of construction, OD, l ength, MOC and number of tubes and hydro test pressure. 2) Self attested copy of certificate of Hydro test witnessed by client/TPI agency. 3) Self attested copy of TPI release note for the complete heat exchangers.
